name: Belfast & the Giant's Causeway
about: Mild and rainy much of the year, like the rest of the British Isles — no real closed season.
overview: Belfast's Titanic Quarter and political murals, paired with the basalt columns of the Giant's Causeway an hour up the Causeway Coastal Route.
costOverview: Belfast runs cheaper than London or Dublin — a full Ulster fry breakfast and a pint both cost noticeably less than equivalent food and drink elsewhere in the UK and Ireland.
